# Command flags

Every flag of the engines' command-line tools, read from the Go source by
`scripts/docs_flags.py`. A test fails when this page and the source disagree.
The tools use Go's `flag` package, so `-name value`, `-name=value` and `--name` all work.
[Using the engines](using.md) says what each tool is for and shows examples.

## mtgsim

`go run -trimpath ./cmd/mtgsim`. Plays seeded games on gorge between bots and checks each by replay.

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-a` | string | none | bot policy name for seat 0 (default: heuristic) |
| `-b` | string | none | bot policy name for seat 1 (default: heuristic) |
| `-decks` | string | none | comma-separated deck names (default: the first -seats of the repo decks) |
| `-dir` | string | `.cards` | corpus directory (holds ir.gob.gz / cardsfolder) |
| `-format` | string | `constructed` | game format: constructed or commander (40 life, commanders in the command zone) |
| `-games` | int | `1` | number of games to play |
| `-mulligans` | int | `0` | London mulligans each seat may take before turn 1 (default 0, none) |
| `-sb-agent` | string | repeatable | register a SpellBench v2 stdio agent: name=/path/to/agent (repeatable) |
| `-seats` | int | `4` | number of seats |
| `-seed` | uint64 | `0` | base seed; game i uses seed+i for both the engine and its bot |
| `-shape` | string | none | write a JSON game-shape census to this file (game rows, then one aggregate) |
| `-v` | bool | `false` | print the deck assigned to each seat before every game |
| `-verify` | bool | `false` | replay each game and compare its event chain against the live run |

## forgec

`go run -trimpath ./cmd/forgec`. Fetches the Forge card corpus, compiles it into gorge's IR and reports coverage. The flags are shared by its four subcommands: `fetch`, `compile`, `report` and `coverage`.

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-dir` | string | `.cards` | working directory for the corpus and IR cache |
| `-out` | string | `.coverage` | coverage: gitignored directory to write coverage.md and summary.md into |
| `-ref` | string | `master` | Forge git ref to fetch |
| `-repo` | string | `cards.ForgeRepo` | Forge git repository to fetch from |
| `-top` | int | `25` | how many missing primitives to list in report |

## cardfuzz

`go run -trimpath ./cmd/cardfuzz`. Plays random and exploring games over the whole corpus on gorge, records failures and tracks which cards and abilities it has reached.

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-autopay` | string | `off` | off\|all\|mixed: which production-bot seats cast through offered payment plans (heuristic.Bot.EnableAutoPayMana); mixed picks per game and seat from the seed |
| `-autopay-mirror` | bool | `false` | mirror each auto-pay planned cast against float-then-cast (opt-in) |
| `-batch` | int | `400` | games per batch (coverage snapshot granularity) |
| `-cpuprofile` | string | none | with -repro: write a CPU profile of the replay here |
| `-dir` | string | `.cards` | corpus directory |
| `-dump-at` | uint64 | `0` | with -repro: print the first pending decision whose Seq is at least this log index (options, payment actions, pool, battlefield) |
| `-explore` | bool | `true` | one seat per game (by seed parity) plays the coverage-exploration policy (heuristic.NewExploreBot) instead of the production bot |
| `-explore-autopay` | bool | `false` | the -explore seat auto-pays too wherever -autopay would select its seat (off by default: the wrapper hides priority mana activations, cutting explore coverage) |
| `-failures` | string | `cardfuzz-failures.jsonl` | append failure records here |
| `-games` | int | `1000` | games to play this run |
| `-hang` | duration | `90*time.Second` | wall-clock budget per game before it is recorded as a 'hang' (its goroutine is abandoned) |
| `-journal` | string | none | append 'start <goroutine> <seed>' / 'end <seed>' around every game: a fatal runtime error (a stack overflow) kills the whole process past any recover, and the journal names the game the crashing goroutine was playing |
| `-line` | int | `1` | 1-based line of -repro to replay |
| `-manabrew` | bool | `false` | play every seat through the ManaBrew wire (mbtest.TranslatingSeat + seeded-random MockClient): one shared census printed at the end, failures record "manabrew": true and replay through -repro; -explore is ignored and -autopay/-explore-autopay are rejected |
| `-max-hangs` | int | `6` | stop the run once this many hung games are leaked (each burns a core) |
| `-max-intents` | int | `20000` | intent cap (recorded as an 'intents' failure) |
| `-max-objects` | int | `20000` | live object cap (recorded as a 'bigboard' failure; 0 disables) |
| `-max-outcome-gap` | float64 | `0` | with -spellbench outcome: fail when the paired 95% interval of the (v2 - native) seat-0 win rate excludes 0 and \|gap\| exceeds this many percentage points (0 disables); a forfeit always fails |
| `-max-rebuild-fail` | float64 | `0.5` | with -spellbench twin and -min-agree: fail when the neutral world could not rebuild the pick for more than this percentage of the run's decisions (0 allows none) |
| `-max-stack` | int | `256<<20` | per-goroutine stack limit in bytes (runtime/debug.SetMaxStack): an unbounded recursion dies here instead of at Go's 1 GB default |
| `-max-turns` | int | `100` | turn cap (a stall, not a failure) |
| `-measure-manual-seat-plans` | bool | `false` | diagnostic: in -autopay off mode, force the payment planner on every priority window so manual_seat_priority_with_plan (the plans the eager publisher would have offered to manual seats) is populated. Rebuilds every seat's payment extension, so it costs runtime; it never changes game outcomes, intents, replay signatures or failure records, and it is ignored in all\|mixed (which already measure) |
| `-min-agree` | float64 | `0` | with -spellbench twin: fail when a decision kind with at least 50 compared decisions agrees below this percentage (0 keeps the any-disagreement rule) |
| `-missing` | bool | `false` | with -report: also list cards cast/played but with abilities never used, and which |
| `-only-pair` | int | `-1` | with -spellbench outcome: play only this pair index (0-based); the report keeps its original pair number |
| `-plan-failures` | bool | `true` | record a game whose planned cast was reversed (kind planrev) or fell back to the manual window (planfb) as a failure |
| `-policy` | string | `bot` | with -spellbench: the bot policy under test |
| `-report` | bool | `false` | print coverage summary from -state and exit |
| `-repro` | string | none | replay a failure record from this JSONL file (with -line) |
| `-sb-v2-seats-both` | bool | `false` | with -spellbench outcome: both seats are v2 agents in the v2 lane (default: seat 0 only, against a native seat 1) |
| `-seed` | uint64 | `1` | base seed; game i of the run plays at hash(seed, games-so-far + i) |
| `-skip` | string | none | JSONL of games not to play ({seed, sig, diag} per line, from a -journal crash): each is recorded as a 'fatal' failure instead |
| `-spellbench` | string | none | twin\|outcome: measure a gorge bot through the SpellBench v2 neutral world against its native play on fuzzed decks (spellbench.go); -autopay off\|all applies, -failures takes the twin disagreements, -repro replays one |
| `-state` | string | `cardfuzz-state.json` | persistent coverage state |
| `-stats` | string | none | write the run's failure counts and auto-pay counters here as JSON |
| `-tape` | bool | `false` | print the resolution kernel (engine/rules/resolve, the default engine path) counters, the legacy-ask census and the predicate-miss census at the end |
| `-tape-worlds` | bool | `false` | with -tape: fork a redealt hypothetical world at every posed tape decision and drive it 6 random intents |
| `-verify` | bool | `true` | replay every finished game and compare |
| `-workers` | int | `8` | parallel games |

## kgen

`go run -trimpath ./dirac/cmd/kgen`. Compiles card pools from gorge's IR into dirac's binary card tables, and answers which cards dirac supports. `cmd/kgen` is a thin main over package `dirac/kgen`.

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-all-blockers` | bool | `false` | with -census-std: keep lowering past a refusal and report every blocker of a card, not only the first of each node |
| `-card-list` | string | none | card list file (one name per line) instead of -decks |
| `-cards` | string | `.cards` | compiled card corpus directory |
| `-census` | bool | `false` | print the (context, param) census instead of generating |
| `-census-std` | bool | `false` | print refusal classes ranked by Standard-set carry instead of generating |
| `-class` | string | `lockstep` | with -refuse: the kind of difference, the refused list's grouping |
| `-decks` | string | none | deck pool directory (*.json) |
| `-dump` | string | none | write a per-card IR dump here instead of generating (never commit it) |
| `-layer-census` | bool | `false` | print the interim layer guard's reach (classified cards, refused pairs and deck pairs) instead of generating |
| `-lir` | bool | `false` | print every card's lowered IR and refusals instead of generating |
| `-ops` | string | none | write this pool's OPS.md to -out instead of generating |
| `-out` | string | none | output directory; with -ops, the output file |
| `-pool` | string | `fdn` | pool name |
| `-refuse` | string | none | write this card's dirac/support/refused entry instead of generating (with -why and -repro) |
| `-repro` | string | none | with -refuse: the game that shows it, POOL:SURFACE:PAIR[:POLICY[:MULLIGANS]] |
| `-sets` | string | none | with -census-std: comma-separated set codes (default dirac/cardset/standard.txt) |
| `-show` | string | none | print the kop.CardDef literal of the card named by the argument, from this pool's table, instead of generating |
| `-supported` | string | none | print name<TAB>true\|false for every entry of this pool's table instead of generating |
| `-synth-pools` | bool | `false` | write the synthetic evidence pools' binary tables under the corpus (make dirac-tables): nothing is written to the source tree |
| `-tables` | bool | `false` | write every pool's binary table under the corpus (make dirac-tables): exit 3 means an ids.tsv changed, rebuild kgen and rerun |
| `-tsv` | string | none | with -census-std: write a per-refusal TSV dump here |
| `-unrefuse` | string | none | delete this card's dirac/support/refused entry instead of generating |
| `-unverified` | bool | `false` | with -supported: cards without lockstep evidence count as playable (a refused card stays false) |
| `-whatif` | string | none | with -lir: also refuse these cards (comma list) and report coverage |
| `-why` | string | none | with -refuse: one line saying what differs |

## dplay

`go run -trimpath ./dirac/cmd/dplay`. Plays seeded games on dirac alone and prints a line per game and a summary.

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-a` | string | `hbot` | seat A's player, who plays the pair's first deck: random, first, hbot or sbt |
| `-b` | string | `random` | seat B's player |
| `-cards` | string | none | gorge corpus directory (default: $GORGE_CARDS, else .cards in or above the working directory) |
| `-config` | string | `configAutopay` | the verified surface to play: lockstep-autopay or lockstep-full |
| `-deck-a` | string | none | deck JSON file for seat A, with -deck-b, instead of a pool |
| `-deck-b` | string | none | deck JSON file for seat B |
| `-decks` | string | none | deck directory (default: the set's pool, under $GORGE_POOLS or the module's .pools, else its committed slice) |
| `-first-pair` | int | `0` | index of the first pair |
| `-max-intents` | int | `20000` | decision cap per game; a capped game is a stall |
| `-max-turns` | int | `100` | turn cap; a capped game is a stall |
| `-mulligan-policy` | string | `coin` | how every seat mulligans: coin, lands, never, constructed or forge |
| `-mulligans` | int | `0` | London mulligans each player may take (0 skips the round) |
| `-out` | string | none | games file, one JSON line per game (default: stdout) |
| `-pairs` | int | `100` | deck pairs, one game each |
| `-pairs-file` | string | none | play these pairs: deckA<TAB>deckB[<TAB>seed] per line; -first-pair skips lines and -pairs, when given, caps them |
| `-pool` | string | none | pool.tsv (default: <decks>/../pool.tsv) |
| `-sample-replay` | float64 | `0` | fraction of games also written as koracle-game-2 records under <out>.replays, which kfuzz -replay re-executes in gorge; needs -out |
| `-seed` | uint64 | `1` | base seed: pairs and game seeds derive from it, as in kfuzz |
| `-set` | string | `fdn` | the card set to play: a deck pool by name, or a synthetic pool (std-trk, tail-NN) |
| `-skip-refused` | bool | `false` | skip a pair the set refuses and count it, instead of failing |
| `-split` | string | `all` | pool split the decks come from: train, eval or all |
| `-summary` | string | none | summary file, one JSON object (default: stderr) |
| `-wall` | duration | `0` | start no game after this much wall time (0: play every pair) |
| `-workers` | int | `1` | games in parallel |

## sbv2dirac

`go run -trimpath ./dirac/cmd/sbv2dirac`. Serves dirac as a SpellBench v2 engine over stdio.

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-corpus` | string | none | compiled Forge corpus directory (default: GORGE_CARDS or .cards) |
| `-decks` | string | none | directory of gorge deck JSON files to serve beside the catalog (catalog_id = file stem) |
| `-source-revision` | string | none | adapter source revision reported in hello_ok |

## kfuzz

`go run -trimpath ./dirac/oracle/cmd/kfuzz`. Plays seeded games on gorge and dirac in lockstep and reports the first decision where they differ.

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-absolute` | bool | `false` | pool runs: exit 1 on any divergence, hang, panic, unmodelled stall, unknown option kind or error skip, or when no game was played; capacity stalls and refusals are counted and do not fail |
| `-allow-unverified` | bool | `false` | pool runs: play the cards the table does not refuse, unverified ones too, as -evidence does |
| `-answerers` | string | `first,rand` | -v2 transcript: comma-separated scripted answerers (first, rand) |
| `-autopay-surface` | bool | `false` | deprecated alias of -surface autopay |
| `-cards` | string | none | gorge corpus directory (default: $GORGE_CARDS, else .cards in or above the working directory) |
| `-coverage` | string | none | write the run's per-card/per-ability coverage TSV (oracle.Coverage) here and print a coverage summary line |
| `-decks` | string | none | pool deck directory (default: the fdn pool's, under $GORGE_POOLS or the module's .pools, else its committed slice) |
| `-events` | int | `0` | -repro: print the last N events of gorge's log when the game ends, objects named by card |
| `-evidence` | string | none | pool runs: play the cards the table does not refuse, unverified ones too, and write the cards the run's clean games evidence (oracle.Coverage.Evidence), one name a line, here |
| `-features` | bool | `false` | vanilla/fdn: also assert the network inputs (dirac/feat vs policynet) at every decision |
| `-first-game` | int | `0` | -v2 transcript: index of the first pool pair (repro anchor) |
| `-first-pair` | int | `0` | index of the first pair |
| `-focus` | string | none | -synth: deal a focus pool instead: every deck holds -focus-per-deck cards of this list (one card a line, enablers after a tab, ';'-separated) beside the enablers they name; the run is named after the file (fx-dsk.txt: fx-dsk) |
| `-focus-per-deck` | int | `oracle.FocusPerDeck` | -focus: focus cards per deck |
| `-game-timeout` | duration | `30*time.Second` | a game with no result after this long, twice (one retry), is recorded as a hang and the run moves on; a hang fails the run (0: no watchdog) |
| `-games` | int | `100` | -v2 transcript: seeded games per answerer |
| `-implicates-all` | bool | `false` | pool runs: name every implicated card instead of the top ten, and print one line per game that fails -absolute: bad-game, pair, seed, outcome, class, the implicated cards joined by \|, the sources of its latest actions joined by \|, the cards of both decks joined by \|, tab-separated; a game that recorded an unknown option kind also prints unknown-game, pair, seed, the kinds joined by \| |
| `-json` | bool | `false` | print the summary as JSON |
| `-keep-going` | bool | `false` | count every divergence instead of stopping at the first |
| `-kernel` | string | `gorge` | the kernel under test: gorge (gorge-vs-gorge self-check), gorge-api (the same through the contract's Kernel surface), vanilla (package kernel on dirac/vanilla's decks), fdn (package kernel on a registered card set's pool pairings) or any other registered pool such as blb (fdn's path on that set and its pool, oracle.Pools; see -list-pools) |
| `-lead` | string | `gorge` | which side leads the lockstep: gorge or kernel (fdn/vanilla paths) |
| `-list-pools` | bool | `false` | print the registered lockstep pools (name, inputs, label, decks, tree digest) and exit |
| `-list-synth` | bool | `false` | print the synthetic evidence pools, one a line, and exit |
| `-max-decisions` | int | `20000` | canonical decision cap; a capped game is a stall |
| `-max-turns` | int | `100` | turn cap; a capped game is a stall |
| `-mulligans` | int | `0` | London mulligans each player may take (0 skips the round) |
| `-out` | string | none | directory for the first divergence's repro.json, and one file a bad game: capacity-<table>-pair<N>.repro.json for a capacity stall, unmodelled-<why>-pair<N>.repro.json for an unmodelled kernel stall, divergent-pair<N>.repro.json for a divergent game (default: none written) |
| `-pairs` | int | `100` | deck pairs (one game each) |
| `-pairs-file` | string | none | pool runs: play these pairs instead of drawing from pool.tsv: deckA<TAB>deckB[<TAB>seed] per line (oracle.ExplicitPairs); -first-pair skips lines and -pairs, when given, caps them |
| `-pass-elision` | bool | `false` | elide priority decisions whose only option is pass (must match the kernel's) |
| `-play-refused` | bool | `false` | pool runs: play the pairs holding a card refused by name too, as scripts/dirac-first-refusals.py settle does |
| `-pods` | int | `0` | -seats above 2: pods to play (one game each; 0: -pairs) |
| `-policy` | string | `random` | random, heuristic, explore (gorge's coverage-exploration bot, cmd/cardfuzz's) or first |
| `-pool` | string | none | pool.tsv (default: <decks>/../pool.tsv) |
| `-reach` | string | none | -synth: write one row per card of the list here: card, how far it got, decks, games, plays in clean games |
| `-replay` | string | none | re-execute this kernel game (koracle-game-2) in gorge and report |
| `-repro` | string | none | re-run this repro in lockstep and report |
| `-seats` | int | `2` | seats a game: 2 plays deck pairs; 3 or 4 plays pods of distinct decks (oracle.PodAt): -kernel gorge in any build, -kernel vanilla or a -synth pool in a build with -tags dirac_mp |
| `-seed` | uint64 | `1` | base seed: pairs and game seeds derive from it (the pairing rule) |
| `-set` | string | `fdn` | the generated card set the fdn kernel plays (a name in dirac/cardset) |
| `-shrink` | int | `200` | shrink reruns for the first divergence (0: none) |
| `-split` | string | `all` | pool split the decks come from: train, eval or all |
| `-stats` | bool | `false` | fdn/blb: print each kernel pool's peak occupancy and the pair that reached it (kstats) |
| `-surface` | string | none | the option surface both sides offer: autopay (neither side offers the plain casts gorge's planner never prices, oracle.Config.GorgeAutopaySurface) or full (default) |
| `-synth` | string | none | play a synthetic evidence pool (make dirac-tables writes them): deal its decks in memory from -seed and report its reach; replaces -kernel, -set and -decks |
| `-synth-decks` | int | `oracle.SynthDecks` | -synth: decks to deal |
| `-v` | bool | `false` | list the unpriced plays by card (fdn: every game's first divergence) |
| `-v2` | string | none | run a v2 engine-parity check instead of lockstep: "transcript" plays the same seeded games on dirac/cmd/sbv2dirac and gorge's env and diffs their transcripts |
| `-v2-max-decisions` | int | `500` | -v2 transcript: v2 decision cap per game (a prefix is compared; 0 uses 500) |
| `-v2-no-chance` | bool | `false` | -v2 transcript: negative control: the gorge host keeps its secret-stream shuffles instead of dealing the dirac kernel's chance (must diff) |
| `-v2-rand-full` | bool | `false` | -v2 transcript: no-op (a rand game is always compared whole; the flag keeps the old spelling working) |
| `-v2-workers` | int | `4` | -v2 transcript: games in parallel |
| `-workers` | int | `1` | games in parallel |

## khbot

`go run -trimpath ./dirac/oracle/cmd/khbot`. Compares gorge's heuristic bot with its port on dirac, decision by decision.

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-autopay-surface` | bool | `true` | oracle.Config.GorgeAutopaySurface (gorge's own autopay surface) |
| `-cards` | string | none | gorge corpus directory (default: $GORGE_CARDS, else .cards in or above the working directory) |
| `-dealt` | string | none | play decks dealt from a pool's table (fdn), as a clone without the deck pool does, instead of -decks and -pool |
| `-decks` | string | none | pool deck directory (default: the fdn pool's, under $GORGE_POOLS or the module's .pools, else its committed slice) |
| `-first-pair` | int | `0` | index of the first pair |
| `-hold` | bool | `false` | arm gorge TimingRules.HoldInstant on both sides (hbot must hold too) |
| `-max-decisions` | int | `20000` | canonical decision cap per game |
| `-pairs` | int | `100` | deck pairs (one game each) |
| `-pass-elision` | bool | `true` | elide single-option decisions (the kernel's default configuration does) |
| `-pool` | string | none | pool.tsv (default: <decks>/../pool.tsv) |
| `-seed` | uint64 | `78` | base seed (the pairing rule) |
| `-split` | string | `eval` | pool split: train, eval or all |
| `-synth` | string | none | play a synthetic evidence pool (make dirac-tables writes them) instead of -decks and -pool |
| `-v` | bool | `false` | print every disagreement |
| `-workers` | int | `4` | games in parallel |

## ksbt

`go run -trimpath ./dirac/oracle/cmd/ksbt`. Compares gorge's sb-tactical bot answering on gorge with the same bot answering through a view built from the dirac position.

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-autopay-surface` | bool | `true` | oracle.Config.GorgeAutopaySurface (gorge's own autopay surface) |
| `-cards` | string | none | gorge corpus directory (default: $GORGE_CARDS, else .cards in or above the working directory) |
| `-decks` | string | none | pool deck directory (default: the fdn pool's, under $GORGE_POOLS or the module's .pools, else its committed slice) |
| `-first-pair` | int | `0` | index of the first pair |
| `-max-decisions` | int | `20000` | canonical decision cap per game |
| `-pairs` | int | `100` | deck pairs (one game each) |
| `-pass-elision` | bool | `true` | elide single-option decisions (the kernel's default configuration does) |
| `-pool` | string | none | pool.tsv (default: <decks>/../pool.tsv) |
| `-seed` | uint64 | `78` | base seed (the pairing rule) |
| `-split` | string | `eval` | pool split: train, eval or all |
| `-v` | bool | `false` | print every disagreement |
| `-workers` | int | `4` | games in parallel |
